# shebang-command [![Build Status](https://travis-ci.org/kevva/shebang-command.svg?branch***REMOVED***master)](https://travis-ci.org/kevva/shebang-command)

> Get the command from a shebang


## Install

```
$ npm install shebang-command
```


## Usage

```js
const shebangCommand ***REMOVED*** require('shebang-command');

shebangCommand('#!/usr/bin/env node');
//***REMOVED***> 'node'

shebangCommand('#!/bin/bash');
//***REMOVED***> 'bash'
```


## API

### shebangCommand(string)

#### string

Type: `string`

String containing a shebang.
